notes: Tuition: the 2 902 € figure is a general institution-wide and national fee schedule for international non-EU students; the programme's own Parcoursup page only states "Par année 178 euros", which applies to non-scholarship students and EU/EEA nationals. The recurring deadline of 1 January is the Bordeaux/Campus France procedure deadline for applicants residing abroad; the programme's own page gives no dated deadline. For a Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat, the programme's own page says candidature is not on Parcoursup but through Études en France / Campus France, which is handled by the task separately.
